Petalock needs 120 MB on drive C: and 119 MB is free. Free some space, then choose Retry.

Petalock is open. Quit it from its icon near the clock (right-click it, then Quit), then choose Retry. Setup never closes it for you. From the keyboard: press Windows+B, move to Petalock’s icon, press the Menu key, then choose Quit.
Petalock’s folder holds files Setup didn’t install. Untick the box below to update in place instead; nothing was changed.
Petalock 0.10.10 is installed here. Make sure Setup has write access to this folder, then choose Retry. Nothing was changed.
Setup leaves your vault files in place.
Connect to the internet, then run Setup again. Petalock needs WebView2 to show its screens. Nothing of Petalock was installed.
The earlier version could not be removed, so Setup stopped before installing. Run Setup again once nothing is using it.
Windows would not take Petalock’s entry in Installed apps, so Setup removed the files it had just copied. Run Setup again to try once more.
Windows refused Petalock’s entry in Installed apps, and Setup could not remove every file it copied. Run Setup again and choose another folder under Options.
Petalock’s files were updated, but Windows would not take the new entry in Installed apps. Setup removed nothing. Run Setup again to try once more.
Setup couldn’t write one of Petalock’s files. Some files were already copied to its folder; running Setup again replaces them.
Setup left your vault files in place.
